# Vonckx Performance

> Vonckx Performance bv is an independent garage in Booischot (Heist-op-den-Berg, province of Antwerp, Belgium) specialising in chiptuning, custom stainless-steel exhausts, tuning, styling, and maintenance and repair of cars and light commercial vehicles. Visits are by appointment, Monday to Friday. The website is in Dutch.

## Contact

- Address: Mechelbaan 22, 2221 Booischot, Belgium
- Phone: +32 479 09 04 44
- Email: vonckxperformance@gmail.com
- Opening hours: by appointment, Monday to Friday
- Company: Vonckx Performance bv, VAT BE1000.028.923
- Booking: contact form at https://vonckxperformance.com/#contact

## Services

- Custom exhausts (Custom uitlaten): fully bespoke exhaust systems in high-grade stainless steel (RVS), from a subtle sound upgrade to a complete custom catback or turboback. Past work includes BMW M2, BMW M5 Touring and Audi RS3.
- Chiptuning: engine-management (ECU) optimisation for more power, more torque and smoother driveability, tailored to the car and the owner's wishes.
- Tuning: performance upgrades, from a single part to a complete build.
- Styling: body kits, wheels, lighting and finishing.
- Maintenance & repair (Onderhoud & reparatie): servicing and repairs for cars and light commercial vehicles.

## How it works

1. Introduction: discuss the customer's wishes and what is feasible for the car.
2. Proposal: a clear plan with a transparent price and timeline.
3. Execution: the work is carried out in Vonckx Performance's own workshop in Booischot.
4. Delivery: handover of the car, with continued after-care.
